thread:
sam: Heads-up: kicking off a surgical entitlement cleanup tied to the payments KMS keyring. found `serviceAccount:payments-worker@redwood.internal` with `roles/cloudkms.admin` on `keyRings/payments` during our quarterly review. tagging for triage.

riley: good catch. that SA should only encrypt/decrypt for tokenization job. where did the admin come from? any deploys that would have needed setIamPolicy?

san: (typo) meant to say tan: i pulled history, looks like a one-off grant from an onboarding script in 2022. likely never removed.

tan: plan proposal: (A) verify last-usage via audit logs, (B) if only encrypt/decrypt present, add a key-level `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`, (C) remove admin at keyring, (D) run a 72h canary with enhanced alerts.

ops-bot: scheduled logs export job `audit-export-4165550000` -> will return `kms.*` events for principal payments-worker@redwood.internal. ETA 3m.

leo: also check for serviceAccountKey.create or IAM bindings elsewhere (org-level) before removing. we had cross-project grants before.

riley: running quick queries now. command used:```gcloud logging read \"protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"serviceAccount:payments-worker@redwood.internal\" AND protoPayload.methodName:(\"Encrypt\" OR \"Decrypt\")\" --freshness=90d --project=payments-prod```

leo: results: only Encrypt/Decrypt calls from the tokenization job; no SetIamPolicy, no serviceAccountKey.create, no unusual IPs.

sam: ok proceed with a staged change. small runbook below (to be put in SEC-2048):
1) create key-scoped binding:```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding tokenize-key --location=us-central1 --keyring=payments --member=serviceAccount:payments-worker@redwood.internal --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter --project=payments-prod```
2) remove admin binding at keyring level:```gcloud kms keyrings remove-iam-policy-binding payments --location=us-central1 --member=serviceAccount:payments-worker@redwood.internal --role=roles/cloudkms.admin --project=payments-prod```
3) enable temporary increase in audit sampling for that SA and add a Grafana panel for KMS Encrypt error rate + PubSub DLQ spikes.

compliance: please ensure logs export artifacts are retained for 180 days and attach to SEC-2048. we'll need evidence for the quarterly attestation.

ops-bot: created ticket SEC-2048, assigned to @sam, priority P2. created ephemeral alert `kms-tokenize-fail-rate` with threshold 0.3% error for 1m.

riley: suggestion: instead of immediate removal, do a slow rollback policy: remove admin, keep key binding, monitor traffic for 24h. if errors >0.3% or any SetIamPolicy from SA appears, revert by re-adding admin and open emergency rollback playbook.

tan: agree. add an IAM Condition restricting binding to `resource.name` for the specific key if possible and add a time-bound justification on the binding annotation. also check Workload Identity usage to avoid long-lived keys.

sam: i'll run the change tomorrow at 07:00 PT, canary until 07:00 PT +3d. tagging infra-sre for dashboard tweaks. attaching logs export and the ticket once done. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
